desc:
💪 A protein thief robbed the gym! Line up with other players, chase the thief around the world, and flex through the holes they smash in walls!

🏋️ TRAIN: Curl, run, bench and squat. Your whole body bulks up!
🥤 REFUEL: Training burns stamina. Grab a shake at the Protein Bar.
🏃 CHASE: Tap the pose that matches the hole to burst through. Wrong pose = lose a heart!
🥫 Kick cans and throw bricks to wear the thief out, then button-mash with your squad and tackle them!
💰 Earn cash for every wall cleared and thief caught. Tougher thieves pay more.
📣 Out of hearts? Cheer on your squad and still get paid if they catch the thief!
🔄 REBIRTH: Max out your muscle, then press CUT to start over and train faster. Earn titles from Rookie to Final Boss!
🏆 Climb the leaderboards and take the gym's podium.
👕 Buy costumes with your cash. Try them on first!
🎮 Play on Xbox & PlayStation, with full controller support!

Every thief has their own look, voice and moves. Bring friends and flex together!
